question: Does immutable-source bilinear sampling follow a continuous bounded gate-weave trajectory more faithfully than rounded integer crops while retaining high-frequency chart contrast and exact integer semantics?

controls.integer_crop: round continuous offsets to nearest integer and crop
controls.analytic_truth: evaluate the same continuous sinusoidal chart at displaced coordinates

forbidden: resample an already transformed prior frame
hide crop, zoom, rotation, perspective, rolling-shutter or registration inside the gate-weave layer
claim the synthetic chart establishes measured film motion or video quality
change interpolation, chart, trajectory, controls or gates after formal scoring

branch_rule.pass: retain immutable-source bilinear sampling as the continuous gate-weave reference and keep integer crop as an explicit lower-quality mode
branch_rule.fail: retain integer crop only and close subpixel sampling without interpolation or threshold rescue

claim_ceiling: Synthetic translation-sampling accuracy and frequency retention only; not measured gate motion, photographic video quality, registration, temporal product readiness or stock calibration.
